source: Figma MCP get_design_context, returned screenshot, and download_assets for text node 529:78.

coinOngComposition.method: Original layered SVGs with their exported glow and original transparent currency glyph PNG. No generated or substitute character.
coinOngComposition.currency: 529:78 uses Inclusive Sans. Its original ink export is used to avoid a fallback-font substitution. The trimmed PNG is aligned to the visual source.

behavior: Existing reward calculation and CLAIM_REWARD reducer are unchanged: up to 3 coins, one claim per quiz session.
Before claiming, the primary button says 코인 받기. After claiming, it becomes 다음 학습하기, matching the received-reward design.
Displayed reward and balance come from shared state, not the source frame's sample +3 and 15 COIN values.
Mixed or zero-correct results use a neutral completion heading instead of falsely claiming all answers were correct.
Rewards remain in localStorage; quiz sessions remain memory-only as before. A missing/reloaded session shows recovery without creating a reward.
limitations: Mobile layout adapts the verified PC composition; mobile node 964:601 was not requested again or visually verified.
Korean text retains the existing application fallback font; the character and its currency glyph use actual Figma assets.
